parameters.name: DataLinkName
parameters.description:
The name of the cross-database query datalink.

> - This parameter is required if UseDsql is set to 1.
> - The DBLink name can contain only lowercase letters and underscores (_).
> - The DBLink name must be globally unique within the tenant.

parameters.name: DatabasePassword
parameters.description: The database password.

parameters.name: DatabaseUser
parameters.description: The database account.

parameters.name: DbaId
parameters.description: The user ID of the DBA for the instance. You can call the [ListUsers](~~141938~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: DdlOnline
parameters.description:
Specifies whether structure change priority is enabled. Valid values:
- **0**: Do not use.
- **1**: Native Online DDL takes priority.
- **2**: DMS lock-free structure change takes priority.

> Supported database types: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL, PolarDB for MySQL engine, MyBase for MySQL, and MySQL from other sources.

parameters.name: EcsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the ECS instance.

> This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to ECS_OWN.

parameters.name: EcsRegion
parameters.description:
The region in which the instance resides.

> This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to RDS, ECS\_OWN, or VPC\_IDC.

parameters.name: EnableSellCommon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the security collaboration feature for the instance.

- Y: Enable.
- N: Do not enable.

parameters.name: EnableSellSitd
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the sensitive data protection feature for the instance.
- Y: Enable sensitive data protection.
- N: Do not enable sensitive data protection.

parameters.name: EnableSellStable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the stable change feature for the instance.

- Y: Enable.
- N: Do not enable.

parameters.name: EnableSellTrust
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable security hosting for the instance.

- Y: Enable security hosting mode.
- N: Do not enable security hosting mode.

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The environment type. Valid values:
- **product**: production environment.
- **dev**: development environment.
- **pre**: pre-release environment.
- **test**: test environment.
- **sit**: SIT environment.
- **uat**: UAT environment.
- **pet**: stress testing environment.
- **stag**: STAG environment.

parameters.name: ExportTimeout
parameters.description: The export timeout period. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The endpoint of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceAlias
parameters.description: The alias of the instance, which helps users quickly identify and locate the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceSource
parameters.description:
The source of the instance. Valid values:

- **PUBLIC_OWN**: self-managed instance connected over the Internet.
- **RDS**: ApsaraDB RDS instance.
- **ECS_OWN**: self-managed instance on an ECS instance.
- **VPC_IDC**: self-managed instance in a VPC-connected IDC.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The database type. For more information about valid values, see [DbType parameter description](~~198106~~).

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description:
The network type. Valid values:

- **CLASSIC**: classic network.
- **VPC**: VPC.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port used to access the instance.

parameters.name: QueryTimeout
parameters.description: The query timeout period. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: SafeRule
parameters.description: If you want to enable the security collaboration feature package, you must configure a security rule set (GroupName) for the instance. You can call the [ListStandardGroups](~~465940~~) or [GetInstance](~~465826~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Sid
parameters.description:
The SID of the instance.

> This parameter is required if InstanceType is set to ORACLE.

parameters.name: SkipTest
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip the connectivity test for the instance. Valid values:
- **true**: Skip.
- **false**: Do not skip.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The data classification template ID. You can call the [ListClassificationTemplates](~~465947~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description: The data categorization templatetype. You can call the [ListClassificationTemplates](~~465947~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can find the tenant ID by hovering over the profile icon in the upper-right corner of the DMS console.

parameters.name: UseDsql
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable cross-instance query. Valid values:
- **0**: Disable.
- **1**: Enable.

> Supported database types: MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle-Compatible), and Redis.

parameters.name: UseSsl
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable SSL connection. After SSL is enabled, DMS connects to the database over SSL. The prerequisite is that the database has SSL enabled. The following options are supported:

- **0**: Default value (DMS and the database service automatically negotiate whether to enable SSL). The system automatically identifies whether the target database has SSL enabled. If the database has SSL enabled, DMS connects to the database over SSL. If the database does not have SSL enabled, DMS connects through a regular connection.
- **1**: Enable SSL connection. If the database does not have SSL enabled, this parameter does not take effect.
- **-1**: Disable SSL connection.

> - This configuration item appears only when the database type is MySQL or Redis.
> - SSL (Secure Sockets Layer) encrypts network Connections at the transport layer, improving the security and integrity of communication data, but increases network connection response time.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description:
The VPC ID of the instance.

> This parameter is required if InstanceSource is set to VPC_IDC.
